Hourly National Weather Service forecast for a corridor

Source: R/wind.R
nws_forecast.Rd

Looks up the NWS forecast grid cell (2.5 km) at the centroid of aoi and returns its hourly wind, gust, direction and humidity for the next ~7 days. United States only; free, no key.

Usage

nws_forecast(aoi, api = nws_api)

Arguments

aoi

An sf/sfc object (any CRS) or a bbox.

api

NWS API root.

Value

A tibble with the same columns as wind_history(); attributes office, grid and updated.
